Kyujanggak itself catalogs the surviving precious-book copy only as a first-half-15th-century, Sejong-reign 甲寅字 witness (1418-1450), not an exact-year print. KOSTMA and Li 2018 associate 授時曆立成/the extant copy with 1434, while Li's later 2022 numerical-table chapter cites the same Kyujanggak collection no. 893 as printed in 1444. Exact surviving-copy print year is therefore unresolved and must not be used as a weighting shortcut. Shi Yunli 1998 and other version studies still establish a substantive early Korean Shoushi-licheng transmission lineage. None of these bibliographic witnesses supplies the six pending target glyph readings. Batch 11U directly reads the 1940 internal 奎章閣貴重圖書目錄: page 0125 explicitly labels 書名/圖書番號/冊數/備考, and page 0129 directly records 授時曆立成 as 圖書番號 893, 1冊, adjacent to the separate 授時曆捷法立成 no.892. Together with the current provider title and 奎貴893 identifier and official collection custody continuity, catalog-item continuity to GK00893_00 is now resolved at identifier level. This still supplies no target folio, glyph, value, or exact print year. Batch 11X separately confirms the official institutional reproduction workflow: the G893 detail page exposes a reproduction-request control and the provider service notice states that microfilm reproduction is delivered by uploading a scanned PDF to the homepage after the request/approval workflow, normally within two weeks unless delayed. The public non-member cart records the 2024-02-01 change from postal paper copies to homepage microfilm-scan PDF publication. No G893 request has been submitted or approved, and fulfillment scope/cost remain unknown; this route supplies zero target-page/glyph/value authority until an actual provider file is obtained. Batch 12CW supersedes the former daylength-table access boundary: Actions run 35324088110 / artifact 10538746764 acquired all 204 source-bound Kyujanggak viewer pages. Direct no-OCR review of 052a reads 授時曆日出入晨昏半晝分 and winter-solstice initial values 晨2842.04 / 日出3092.04 / 半晝1907.96 / 日入6907.96 / 昏7157.96, yielding daylight 38.1592 ke. Direct review of 077a reads the summer-solstice initial mirror 晨1657.96 / 日出1907.96 / 半晝3092.04 / 日入8092.04 / 昏8342.04, yielding daylight 61.8408 ke. This directly fixes the G893 table to the Beijing/Yandu Shoushi numerical branch and disproves raw numeric identity with the 1578 Sanming 59/41 display. Exact surviving-copy print year remains unresolved within the provider's Sejong-era range. The six legacy G893 textual/numeric controls from Batch 11 are not silently closed by whole-volume acquisition and require page-specific collation.
